description: ol-reserved-word (issue #837, maintainer ruling #833): DECLARING `mod` collides, with `namespace: "reserved"` -- the same namespace as its siblings `and`/`or`/`not`, NOT `"primitive"`. All four are word-spelled operators of the expression grammar rather than callable primitives (spec/grammar.md:378), and `mod` was the only one of the four missing from the keyword list, which is why `define mod` checked clean before this slice while `define and` already raised. Its token class is a separate, independent axis and does NOT change -- `mod` stays `operator`, exactly as `and` does, because spec/grammar.md:378 makes the `keyword` token class and the keyword list "different sets on purpose". Binding and calling `mod` are unaffected: keyword-mod-binds-and-calls-freely pins those. `"check": true` (semantic-checker only) -- nothing is executed and no events are produced.
